adjudications.evidence: Software is named, and named prominently. `machine_annotation_tools` lists four tools with descriptions: 'node2vec' ('Deep learning model used to represent each protein as a feature vector based on its protein-protein interaction neighborhood'), 'DenseNet-121' ('Convolutional neural network pre-trained for object recognition in protein immunofluorescence confocal images'), 'GPT-4' ('Generative large language model used, via the Gene Set AI (GSAI) pipeline ... to generate descriptive names for protein assemblies'), and 'HiDeF' ('Hierarchical community Decoding Framework used for pan-resolution community detection'). `preprocessing_strategies` describes the same chain and ends 'Community detection is performed based on the all-by-all similarities of pairs of proteins in the co-embedding space. The resulting hierarchy of protein communities is output as the final cell map.' `labeling_strategies.data_annotation_platform` names 'Gene Set AI (GSAI) pipeline guiding the GPT-4 model.' `external_resources` names 'Cell Mapping Toolkit, implementing the end-to-end cell map construction pipeline as a series of Python packages, at https://github.com/idekerlab/cellmaps_pipeline', 'FAIRSCAPE AI-readiness framework' and 'Integrative Modeling Platform (IMP) package'.
